plugins.name: arc-design
plugins.description: Design new UI with profiles and styles (design), give existing UI a new look (redesign), remove the generated look (restyle), measure rendering defects on a running page (ui-check), interaction and state rules (ui-interaction), and trace what controls actually do to state (state-check).

plugins.name: arc-kit
plugins.description: The user's daily session defaults (arc), standalone planning and review skills (brainstorming, plan-auditor, executor, verifier), supervise, debug, research, writing, handoff, refactor, conventions, fresh-air, the test-runner, worker, and reviewer agents, and the comment-lint, test-guard, arc-compact, destructive-guard, and agent-git-guard hooks.

plugins.name: mgi-kit
plugins.description: Skills for the MGI .NET, TypeScript, Azure and Azure DevOps stack: api-contract, dotnet-upgrade, efcore-review, ado-pipelines-advisor, ado-work-item, azure-diagnose, and the dotnet-guard hook.
